game.q: “i won’t raise mine.” the qur’an gives his reason. what is it?
opts: he thought it was a bluff
“i fear God, Lord of the worlds”

wrong.bluff: no. he took the threat seriously, and still held back.
wrong.weak: his restraint wasn’t weakness. it was a choice.

game.right: YES. he feared God more than he feared his brother. that’s where his restraint came from.

end.line: one brother refused to raise his hand, and the qur’an made every life weigh as much as all people.
end.l2: every life weighs as much as all.
